title: Vampire Vape Sweet Tobacco E-Liquid 10ml
description: Take your vaping to a whole new level of delicious flavours with this luscious Sweet Tobacco Vampire Vape. Offering a pairing of classic tobacco flavours and a dash of velvety caramel. All to create an E Liquid flavour that is both classic and delightfully unique. With each inhale of Sweet Tobacco by Vampire Vape, you'll be greeted by the warmth of tobacco. Whilst the exhale unveils a smooth caramel layered undertone that lingers on your palate. All to deliver a sweetened caramel tobacco indulgence that can satisfy even the most discerning tobacco vape enthusiasts. Each bottle of this Sweet Tobacco Vampire Vape E-Liquid offers a balanced blend of PG (Propylene Glycol) and VG (Vegetable Glycerin). Ensuring that it can deliver maximum flavour and satisfying clouds. Please Note: That the specific PG/VG ratio varies depending on the nicotine strength in each bottle of nicotine E Liquid. For the 3 mg nicotine strength, the E-Liquid has a 50VG/50PG ratio. Whilst the 3 mg, 6 mg, 12 mg, and 18 mg nicotine strengths contain a 40VG/60PG ratio. Sweet Tobacco by Vampire Vape is a versatile blend that can be used with most vape devices to deliver a satisfying vaping experience. Making it ideal for use with low-powered starter kits, pen-vape kits, and pod kits. If you love this 10ml bottle of Vampire Vape juice, why not explore their other equally delicious popular flavours. Their iconic E-Liquid collection offers a broad range to choose from to suit a variety of vaping needs. So whether you're looking for your next seriously smooth nicotine salt Vampire Vape Nic Salt for a perfectly smooth throat hit. Or inspired to make your own vape juice blends with their Vampire Vape Flavour Concentrates. You're sure to find a vape juice flavour and type that suits your vaping needs.
